title: Exercise Unix cleanup drain and registry-capacity refusal paths
outcome: Exercise Unix cleanup drain and registry-capacity refusal paths
acceptance: Isolated behavioral tests cover draining pending and failed cleanup controllers, the CLI failure disposition for unproved cleanup, and refusal when pending controller capacity is exhausted.
Tests exercise member-enumeration, root-layout/state and cleanup-deadline failures with typed failures and retained ownership, without relying on registry state owned by concurrently running tests.
